structures.name: Lateral Ventricle
structures.about: The paired cerebrospinal fluid cavities within each cerebral hemisphere, curving beneath the corpus callosum.

structures.name: Corpus Callosum
structures.about: The great commissure joining the two cerebral hemispheres, seen in section as a broad white band above the ventricles.

structures.name: Fornix
structures.about: The arching fiber bundle carrying hippocampal output forward to the mammillary bodies and septal region.
